Aurionpro Solutions Limited is a global leader in providing advanced technology solutions with a focus on Banking, Payments, Transit, Data Center Services, and Government sectors, leveraging Enterprise AI to Make comprehensive technology for our clients worldwide.

Role Overview
Responsible for managing and optimizing IT Service Management and IT Asset Management platforms, along with supporting enterprise security tools to ensure smooth IT operations and compliance.

Key Responsibilities
  • Administer and support ITSM tools Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus, Zoho ITAM
  • Manage end-to-end IT service processes incident, problem, change, asset management
  • Configure workflows, automation, and reporting in ITSM platforms

Required Skills
  • Strong experience in Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus and ITAM
  • Good understanding of ITIL processes Incident, Change, Problem, Asset Management
  • Exposure to security tools like Trend Micro Deep Security and Imperva DAM
Soft Skills
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Good communication and stakeholder management
Qualification - Bachelors degree in computer scienceIT or related field
